title: Leap year check says 1900 was a leap year
summary: `isLeapYear(year)` should return `true` for years divisible by 4, except century years, which must be divisible by 400. `isLeapYear(1900)` should be `false` but returns `true`.
hint: Century years such as 1900 need to be divisible by 400, not just 100.
